cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.text: I'll name whoever reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine. One name each.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A department isn't a name. We can reduce the exchange, but please be precise about what you're offering.

reason: Preserve the strong two-level exchange while making S03 correct both undervaluation and an over-inclusive offer.
